title: Full-Bridge Converter (Isolated)
description: Isolated full-bridge (H-bridge) converter: four NMOS switches driven in diagonal pairs, 2:1 coupled-inductor transformer with primary RC snubber, and a full-wave rectifier into an LC filter. Steps 48 V down to roughly 7.4 V (D=0.175 per pair, fsw=100 kHz). Authored clean-room with qspice-mcp tools and validated end-to-end.
